responsibility: This shell-script template generates wrapper executables used in the build tree to invoke target tools such as as, collect-ld/ld, nm, and dsymutil. It selects between in-tree binutils programs and configured external originals, handles linker variants like bfd, gold, and plugin-aware linking, copes with libtool relink recursion, and thereby provides GCC's build and testsuite with stable tool entry points before installation.
